notes.title: Special sale comes along with update!
notes.content:
hi everyone,

Today we have several good news for you. 一字不落 finally has its English name 'Chinatris', which means Chinese meets Tetris!

Chinatris will run a 50% off discount from April 20 to April 27 PST. In the meantime, a new game mode called Infinite mode will be added to the game along with new achievements and official English supported.

In Infinite mode, you are going to use 8 Chinese character components to form different target characters. When you beat the level, the characters in the bottom will be removed. The more level you accomplish, much harder will the game become. How many levels can you finish?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36335489/9c86e90235af83092238f668790cecacb80ddca6.png[/img]

notes.title: 《一字不落》1月9日更新
notes.content:
《一字不落》
1月9日更新
1.调整了第17关，增加了空格子数量；新的过关条件为：囚侣因自呋旧倡昋仲咽偘

因为有太多玩家反馈第17关太难，而且我们收到了很多类似的差评，所以最终我们决定调整第17关，“丶”和“丨”在17关都有了作用，空格子的数量也增加了，希望大家会喜欢新的第17关。

notes.title: 《一字不落》1月6日更新公告
notes.content:
《一字不落》
1月6日更新公告
1.修正了第八关无法解锁“红红火火”成就的bug
2.修正了一次生成的多个新字时,能和同一个老字组合时,会产生文字重叠的bug
3.修正了暂停时UI在某些分辨率下出现遮挡的问题
4.略微修改了24关
5.修正了 土,干,㵘,槑,噩 的组合方式
